# Drake's Workshop - LLM context

> Public creator docs for **runtime Lua** (systems, libs, host whitelist). Do not invent C# gameplay APIs. Game source is private; this repo hosts markdown only.

## Primary handoff (paste or fetch)

- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/drakethos/DrakesWorkshopRelease/main/docs/lua-api/AI-CONTEXT.md - full constraints + API cheat sheets + boot order

## Human / browsable docs

- https://github.com/drakethos/DrakesWorkshopRelease/blob/main/docs/lua-api/README.md - index
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/drakethos/DrakesWorkshopRelease/main/docs/lua-api/constraints.md - creator rules
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/drakethos/DrakesWorkshopRelease/main/docs/lua-api/host-api.md - host whitelist
- https://github.com/drakethos/DrakesWorkshopRelease/blob/main/docs/lua-api/libs/ - helper libraries
- https://github.com/drakethos/DrakesWorkshopRelease/blob/main/docs/lua-api/systems/ - systems packs
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/drakethos/DrakesWorkshopRelease/main/docs/lua-api/examples/triple-jump-pete.md - worked example
